subject: Help importing our regional attorney directory via CSV
body: Hi there, We have a spreadsheet of 450 regional attorneys with categories like Corporate Law and Family Law. How exactly do we import this CSV without overwriting existing categories in Brilliant Directories? Is there a template we should follow?
expected_behavior: Explain navigating to My Members >> Member Categories >> Import Categories, CSV formatting, and UTF-8 requirement. Cite support article.

subject: URGENT: Stripe webhook failing on recurring monthly renewals
body: Hello, Our Stripe webhook endpoint is throwing 500 errors whenever recurring monthly subscriptions attempt to renew. Can you tell us which webhook events need to be active in Stripe and where we verify the webhook secret in Brilliant Directories admin?
expected_behavior: Provide instructions for Finance >> Payment Gateways, copy Webhook URL, and list customer.subscription.deleted and invoice events.

subject: Immediate full refund request - billing error on renewal
body: I was charged $450 this morning for an annual renewal that I asked to cancel two weeks ago. I demand an immediate full refund back to my credit card today. If not refunded within 24 hours I will dispute the charge with my bank.
expected_behavior: Acknowledge distress empathetically, do NOT guarantee or promise refund amounts directly, explain refund review process, and route to billing escalation.

subject: Quote Request: Custom mobile app and directory re-skinning
body: Hi team, We want to build an iOS and Android native app that syncs with our Brilliant Directories member database, along with a complete custom re-skin of our search layout. What is your estimated fixed price and timeline to deliver this?
expected_behavior: Do NOT promise fixed prices or binding deadlines. Explain need for scope consultation and schedule discovery call.

subject: How to set up custom domain and free SSL
body: We purchased our domain on Namecheap and want to point it to our directory site. Could you walk us through the DNS A record and CNAME settings, and explain how the SSL certificate gets installed?
expected_behavior: Explain pointing A record '@' to BD IP, CNAME 'www', and clicking 'Install Free SSL' in dashboard. Cite article.

subject: Can we send automated mass newsletters to 25,000 members?
body: We have 25,000 members in our directory. Does Brilliant Directories support sending mass email blasts to all 25,000 directly from the admin panel, or are there server sending limits we need to be aware of?
expected_behavior: Explain built-in newsletter tool (5,000/mo limit) and advise connecting external SMTP/Mailchimp for 25k contacts.

subject: COMPLAINT: Member search map is showing blank gray tiles
body: Our site launched yesterday and all our doctors are complaining that the search map is completely broken, just showing gray boxes. This is causing huge embarrassment with our stakeholders. Fix this immediately!
expected_behavior: De-escalate professionally, check Google Maps API key / billing configuration in General Settings, offer immediate troubleshooting steps.

subject: How does automatic lead matching work with zip codes?
body: Hi, When a website visitor submits a quote request form for auto repair, how does the system decide which mechanics receive the lead? Can we limit it to mechanics within a 20-mile radius?
expected_behavior: Explain Leads >> Lead Settings, category match rules, radius limits, and member recipients cap. Cite article.

subject: Integrating direct cryptocurrency payments for premium vendor plans
body: We want to allow our wedding vendors to pay for their annual featured listings using Ethereum or Bitcoin. Does Brilliant Directories have a native crypto payment gateway add-on available right now?
expected_behavior: State clearly that native crypto gateway is not built-in, mention custom iFrame/widget options, and escalate for technical consultant review.

subject: Follow-up: Scoping call from Tuesday regarding API webhooks
body: Hi, Following up on our Tuesday discussion regarding syncing new member registrations to our HubSpot CRM via webhooks. Have you reviewed the endpoint requirements yet?
expected_behavior: Acknowledge follow-up on HubSpot CRM webhook integration, reference scope requirements, confirm next steps.

subject: Configuring multi-tier membership pricing and trial periods
body: We want 3 tiers: Free Listing, Pro ($29/mo with 14-day free trial), and VIP ($299/yr). Where do we set up the 14-day trial period so users aren't charged immediately?
expected_behavior: Explain Finance >> Membership Plans, editing the Pro tier, and configuring the Free Trial Days field. Cite article.

subject: Exporting full member database to CSV for offline audit
body: Where is the export button located in the admin panel to download all member records including their custom fields?
expected_behavior: Point to My Members >> Member Export, explain filtering options and CSV download. Cite article.

subject: URGENT: Site down with database connection timeout error
body: Help! Our live site is showing 'Error establishing a database connection' on the homepage. We have active marketing campaigns driving traffic right now!
expected_behavior: Acknowledge emergency, escalate directly to high-priority infrastructure support, verify server uptime.

subject: Social media links not appearing in website footer
body: I added our company LinkedIn and Twitter URLs into General Settings, but the icons still do not appear in the footer of our directory. Did I miss a setting?
expected_behavior: Verify Settings >> General Settings >> Social Media Tab, ensure full https:// URLs, check footer widget layout.

subject: New Project: Enterprise real estate MLS data sync integration
body: Hello, We are looking to contract an engineer to build an automated daily sync between our state MLS RETS feed and our Brilliant Directories property listings. We have an API spec document ready.
expected_behavior: Express enthusiasm for the MLS integration project, request the API spec document, and propose a scoping discovery session.

subject: Cancellation of add-on package within 30-day money-back window
body: Please cancel our VIP Booster Add-on package and process the refund as stated in your 30-day guarantee. We ordered on Oct 2nd.
expected_behavior: Confirm receipt of cancellation request, refrain from immediate payment confirmation, pass to billing team for verification.

subject: How to customize transactional email templates with member variables
body: Can you explain how to insert dynamic member variables like %first_name% and %listing_url% into our welcome email templates?
expected_behavior: Guide user to Emails >> Email Templates, explain variable picker dropdown and template testing.

subject: COMPLAINT: Leads being sent to competitors in neighboring counties
body: Our top paying sponsor is furious because leads from their territory are being assigned to unverified free members 40 miles away. Fix the lead routing radius now!
expected_behavior: Acknowledge frustration, explain how to restrict radius and limit lead recipient tiers in Leads >> Lead Settings, escalate for audit.

subject: Does the system support multi-currency checkouts for international vendors?
body: We have vendors in the UK and US. Can a single directory checkout in GBP for British vendors and USD for American vendors simultaneously?
expected_behavior: Note that BD sets a primary default website currency; multi-currency simultaneous checkout requires custom gateway handling or multi-site setup.

subject: Quote Request: Custom HIPAA compliance patient intake form
body: Can you provide a firm estimate and timeline for building a HIPAA-compliant encrypted patient intake form connected to our directory?
expected_behavior: Refuse to give ad-hoc HIPAA binding quotes. Warn regarding compliance prerequisites and offer a security scoping review.

subject: How to set up custom search filters for travel destinations
body: How do we create a dropdown filter on our homepage that allows tourists to filter travel agencies by Cruise, Adventure, or Luxury?
expected_behavior: Explain Content >> Edit Post Settings or Search Settings, creating custom form field options and linking to search filter widget.

subject: Where do I configure our corporate SPF and DKIM records?
body: Our notification emails are going to Gmail spam folders. Which SPF include record does Brilliant Directories require us to add to our DNS?
expected_behavior: Explain Emails >> Email Accounts, connecting custom SMTP (SendGrid/Mailgun) with verified SPF/DKIM records to avoid spam flags.

subject: Follow-up: Design wireframes for student matching portal
body: Checking in to see if your team reviewed the wireframes we sent over last Friday for the student tutor matching portal?
expected_behavior: Confirm receipt of wireframes, state current review status, and set expectations for feedback delivery.

subject: How to restrict member contact info behind a paid login
body: We only want paying members to be able to view direct phone numbers and emails on member profile pages. How do we configure this permission?
expected_behavior: Explain Finance >> Membership Plans, editing the plan permissions, and toggling 'Show Contact Details to Logged-In Members Only'.

subject: Can Brilliant Directories generate QR codes for member badges?
body: Does Brilliant Directories have a native feature to automatically generate QR codes on member profile badges that link to their digital vCard?
expected_behavior: State that native automated QR vCard badges are not standard out-of-the-box, but can be embedded with a small JavaScript QR library.

subject: COMPLAINT: Billing charged client twice during server glitch
body: One of our enterprise advertisers was charged $890 twice due to a duplicate webhook call yesterday. They are threatening legal action if not resolved immediately.
expected_behavior: De-escalate with highest priority, explain immediate review by billing department, do NOT make unauthorized financial waivers in writing.

subject: How to change website default currency from USD to EUR
body: Where in the settings do we change the currency symbol and format for all our membership plan pricing tables to Euros?
expected_behavior: Direct user to Settings >> General Settings >> Localization Tab, select currency EUR.

subject: Quote Request: Zapier app integration for member leads
body: We need an estimate to connect our Brilliant Directories lead submission form to Zapier so our installers receive SMS alerts via Twilio.
expected_behavior: Explain BD Webhook capability and how Zapier Webhooks can receive leads natively without expensive custom coding. Offer scoping call.

subject: How to set up free memberships with mandatory admin approval
body: We want volunteers to register for free, but their profiles must stay inactive until our team manually reviews and approves their credentials. How do we configure this?
expected_behavior: Guide to Finance >> Membership Plans >> Edit Plan >> Post-Sign Up settings, set 'Account Status After Signup' to 'Pending Approval'.

subject: Members unable to upload profile photos - 413 Payload Too Large
body: Our boat captains keep getting a 413 error when uploading boat photos. Where can we increase the maximum file upload size limit in the dashboard?
expected_behavior: Explain photo upload limits in General Settings / Image settings, advise on client-side compression or increasing max image size.

subject: Cancellation request for unused hosting add-on
body: Please remove the SSL Managed Add-on from our monthly invoice as we have migrated our DNS to Cloudflare. Cancel effective immediately.
expected_behavior: Acknowledge request to remove add-on, outline cancellation steps in billing portal, and confirm review by account executive.

subject: New Project: Custom QuickBooks Online bidirectional invoicing sync
body: We would like to hire your development team to build a real-time integration that pushes paid invoices from Brilliant Directories to QuickBooks Online.
expected_behavior: Detail standard webhook/API capabilities for QuickBooks integration, outline discovery scope, schedule meeting.

subject: How to translate frontend button text into French
body: Where can we edit frontend phrases like 'Claim Listing', 'Contact Member', and 'Search Now' into French?
expected_behavior: Explain Settings >> Text Labels, searching for specific phrases, and inputting French translations.

subject: Can we run a private member community forum inside BD?
body: Does Brilliant Directories have a native bulletin board or message forum module where members can post threads and reply to each other?
expected_behavior: Clarify that BD includes Community Articles and Discussion posts, but dedicated nested forum software (like Discourse) requires third-party embedding.

subject: URGENT: Google Maps API billing threshold exceeded
body: All directory addresses are showing 'This page can't load Google Maps correctly'. Our clinic directory is useless without maps! What do we do?
expected_behavior: Explain checking Google Cloud Console for quota/billing errors, verifying API key restrictions in General Settings.

subject: Quote Request: Custom single-sign-on (SSO) with Okta and SAML
body: We need to integrate corporate SAML 2.0 / Okta SSO so our fund managers can sign in automatically without passwords. What is the quote and timeline?
expected_behavior: Explain enterprise SSO architecture requirements, avoid instant pricing commitments, initiate technical discovery.

subject: How to set up location radius search in kilometers instead of miles
body: Our members are in Europe and India. How do we configure the radius search filter to display kilometers rather than miles?
expected_behavior: Navigate to Settings >> General Settings >> Localization, toggle Distance Measurement from Miles to Kilometers.

subject: COMPLAINT: Spam bots submitting hundreds of fake member profiles
body: Over the weekend our site was flooded with 600 spam accounts selling sunglasses. Why isn't Google reCAPTCHA blocking these automated signups?
expected_behavior: Acknowledge spam impact, explain enabling Google reCAPTCHA v2/v3 in General Settings >> Integrations, guide bulk spam member deletion.

subject: Follow-up: Logo design and header navigation revisions
body: Hi team, Did you get a chance to upload the revised SVG logo we sent yesterday and adjust the header navigation spacing?
expected_behavior: Acknowledge follow-up on SVG logo and header spacing, report status, confirm scheduled deployment.

subject: How to set up member reviews and star ratings
body: Where do we enable star reviews for member profiles, and can we require admin approval before member reviews are published publicly?
expected_behavior: Explain Content >> Member Reviews, setting moderation to 'Require Admin Approval' before reviews go live.

subject: Refund dispute: Yearly maintenance plan renewal cancellation
body: I sent an email 3 days before renewal asking not to renew. Your billing system still debited $350. Please refund this immediately.
expected_behavior: Reassure customer, cite internal policy review, forward to billing operations without unilateral financial commitments.

subject: How to bulk update member subscription status from expired to active
body: We have 80 seasonal landscapers whose accounts expired over winter. Can we bulk update their status without editing each profile manually?
expected_behavior: Navigate to My Members >> Search Members, filter by Expired, select all, and use Bulk Actions >> Change Status to Active.

subject: New Project: Custom interactive 3D room planner widget
body: We are seeking a development partner to embed an interactive 3D WebGL room planner inside our designer directory member profiles.
expected_behavior: Clarify custom widget embedding capabilities in BD profile templates, outline discovery roadmap.

subject: URGENT: Suspicious login attempts from overseas IP range
body: Our security monitoring detected over 2,000 failed admin login attempts from an IP block in Eastern Europe. Does BD support IP blocking or Cloudflare WAF integration?
expected_behavior: Treat as security incident, recommend enabling Cloudflare proxy with WAF rule blocking, escalate to technical architect.

subject: Can members schedule Zoom meetings directly from their directory profiles?
body: Do member profiles support direct Zoom calendar booking, or do members need to paste an external Calendly link into their profile bio?
expected_behavior: Explain that native Zoom booking is not built-in, but Calendly and Acuity iFrames can be embedded into profile tabs or custom fields.

subject: How to edit automated lead notification email text sent to contractors
body: Where do we customize the email alert that gets sent to our contractors when a homeowner requests a solar quote?
expected_behavior: Guide to Emails >> Email Templates, locate 'lead-matched-notification' template, customize copy and test.

subject: COMPLAINT: Search results slow to load on mobile devices
body: Our search page takes over 9 seconds to load on mobile 4G connections. Our members are complaining that the site is sluggish and unprofessional.
expected_behavior: Acknowledge performance concerns, recommend image optimization, reducing search results per page, and verifying widget caching.

subject: Quote Request: Custom multi-vendor marketplace checkout system
body: We want visitors to purchase handmade products from 5 different artisans in a single cart, splitting funds via Stripe Connect. Can you quote this?
expected_behavior: Highlight high complexity of multi-vendor Stripe Connect split payouts, decline immediate binding quote, propose full architectural scoping call.

subject: Follow-up: Status of CSV import validation check
body: Following up to confirm if the corrupted publisher CSV file we submitted for cleanup has been checked and verified?
expected_behavior: Acknowledge file review status, verify encoding fixes, and provide clear timeline for final confirmation.

subject: How to set up featured members to always display at the top of search
body: We want our Premium Tier members to always display above Free members in search results regardless of alphabetical sorting. Where is this priority configured?
expected_behavior: Navigate to Finance >> Membership Plans >> Edit Plan >> Search Priority, set Premium plan priority order to 1 and Free plan to 2.
